items.period: Small seal script style represented in a modern vector drawing; the file page labels it Shuowen seal style.
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 頁 in Shuowen seal style. CUHK’s paleographic account describes small-seal 頁 as omitting the hair strokes found in some earlier forms.
items.alt: Black vector outline of the character 頁 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a clearly identified later form for comparison with the database’s account of earlier oracle and bronze shapes; source page states the precise style and gives the direct original file link.
items.rights: The Commons page identifies the vector as public domain and says attribution is appreciated but not required. The page also records historical courtesy/permission in its source metadata; retain the stated page terms for this specific file.

limitations.text: This asset is a modern vector drawing, not an ancient inscription photograph. Its seal-style label describes the form represented, not the date when the file was drawn.
No Xiaoxuetang form image is included: the inspected character query did not reveal a usable individual record or direct image URL, and no query-specific CC0 notice was verified in this run.
